FighterHangar.title: Fighter Hangar
FighterHangar.description: The Fighter Hangar is an internal module that can carry Ship-Launched Fighters.

FragmentCanonWeapon.title: Fragment Cannon
FragmentCanonWeapon.description: A weapon module that fires burst containing 12 projectiles, similar to a shotgun. Very effective against armour and less effective against shields.

FuelScoop.title: Fuel Scoop
FuelScoop.description: Allows you to refuel your fuel tank from most of the stars. You have to fly to the star close enough to start refueling.

FuelTank.title: Fuel Tank
FuelTank.description: Fuel is needed for warp jumps between different planet systems. The bigger your fuel tank is, the further you can fly without refueling.

GaussWeapon.title: Gauss Gun
GaussWeapon.description: A powerful electromagnetic projectile weapon that inflicts both thermal and kinetic damage.

Heatsink.title: Heatsink Launcher
Heatsink.description: Allows to reset ship heat in a moment.

Hull.title: Hull
Hull.description: The type of spacecraft hull affects the resistance to various types of damage.

HullReinforcement.title: Hull Reinforcement
HullReinforcement.description: Additional parts of ship hull which allow to take more damage before the spacecraft is totally destroyed.

LaserWeapon.title: Beam Laser
LaserWeapon.description: An energy weapon that continuously emits a laser beam. The Beam Laser inflicts thermal damage. Very effective against shields and less effective against armour.

LifeSupport.title: Life Support
LifeSupport.description: Turns on if the spacecraft is critically damaged, and allows you to control the spacecraft for some time even if it is depressurized.

MineWeapon.title: Mines
MineWeapon.description: Mines are charges that explode a short time after the enemy approaches. Mine activation takes 2 seconds after dropping. Mines have stabilizing engines that allow them to be used even while moving.

MiningWeapon.title: Mining Laser
MiningWeapon.description: Allows to extract minerals and metals from asteroids. Activated automatically when you tap and hold the asteroid down.

MissileWeapon.title: Missiles
MissileWeapon.description: A weapon module that launches explosive-tipped missiles.

PhaseAnalyser.title: Energy wakes scanner
PhaseAnalyser.description: Allows you to receive data on the use of warp drives and energy shields.

PirateScanner.title: Criminals Scanner
PirateScanner.description: Scans the ship for the presence on the wanted list. Increases the elimination reward. It turns on automatically when there is a target for the ship.

PlanetScanner.title: Planet Scanner
PlanetScanner.description: Detects unknown planets. Responsible for scanning the planet surface and thus makes research data many times more valuable.

PlasmaGunWeapon.title: Plasma Cannon
PlasmaGunWeapon.description: A weapon module that fires slugs of superheated plasma. Its projectiles travel relatively slowly, and they require a brief period to recharge after each shot. Same effectiveness against shields and armor.

PowerDistributor.title: Power Distributor
PowerDistributor.description: Regulates the distribution of power from the Power Plant between the ship's main subsystems

PowerPlant.title: Power Plant
PowerPlant.description: Produces energy which is then consumed by all the spacecraft modules.

PulseLaserWeapon.title: Pulse Laser
PulseLaserWeapon.description: An energy weapon that emits intermittent laser blast. The Pulse Laser inflicts thermal damage. Very effective against shields and less effective against armour.

RailgunWeapon.title: Railgun
RailgunWeapon.description: Electromagnetic projectile weapon that inflicts both thermal and kinetic damage. Partially passes through ship shields.

RepairModule.title: Repair Module
RepairModule.description: Allows to repair other modules in case there are enough spare parts.

SeismicCharges.title: Seismic charges
SeismicCharges.description: The seismic charge launcher is designed to destroy the integrity of asteroids, allowing access to more valuable resources.

Sensors.title: Sensors
Sensors.description: Used for detecting the nearest spacecrafts and objects.

ShieldCellBank.title: Shields Cell Bank
ShieldCellBank.description: An energy capacitor for quick recovery of shields. Its usage increases heat load significantly.

Shields.title: Shields
Shields.description: Energy shield which can take a certain amount of damage before the hull is damaged.

ShieldsBooster.title: Shields Booster
ShieldsBooster.description: Increase the strength of a ship's shields which allows to take more damage.

SpectrumAnalyzer.title: Spectrum Analyzer
SpectrumAnalyzer.description: Displays spectral data of space bodies, allows to estimate compositions of unknown planets and their approximate positions in a system.

Thrusters.title: Thrusters
Thrusters.description: Thrusters are responsible for acceleration and angular rate of spacecraft.

TitanLanceWeapon.title: Energy Lance
TitanLanceWeapon.description: An energy weapon that continuously emits a laser beam. The Lance inflicts thermal damage. The longer the beam continues, the more damage is dealt.

TorpedoWeapon.title: Torpedoes
TorpedoWeapon.description: A weapon module that launches explosive-tipped missiles. Low speed of the missile is compensated by a long targeting range.

VehicleHangar.title: Planetary Vehicle
VehicleHangar.description: Planetary Vehicle module required for landing on planets. Planetary Vehicle allows you to collect resources from the surface of planets.

ZenLaserWeapon.title: Zentarks cannon
ZenLaserWeapon.description: An energy weapon that emits intermittent laser blast. The Pulse Laser inflicts thermal damage.

ZentarksShadowModule.title: Shadow jump module
ZentarksShadowModule.description: A module that replaces the afterburner with Zentarks technology for local teleportation.
